errors.message: Could not find a declaration file for module 'uuid'
'timestamp' does not exist in type 'RunSummary' - RunSummary interface missing timestamp field
errors.rootCause: shared/types.ts RunSummary interface extends Versioned (has createdAt) but not timestamp directly. test-helpers.ts generateTestSummary() uses 'timestamp' key that doesn't exist in RunSummary type.
affectedTests: All state-machine.test.ts tests that use generateTestSummary()

tests.errorMessage: State machine async lock is released before concurrent promise sees it. Both transitions complete because transitionState is async and JavaScript is single-threaded - the 'stateLock' flag is set and unset within a single microtask queue drain.
tests.rootCause: The stateLock boolean is set synchronously but the concurrent promise is also synchronous - there is no actual async pause between lock acquisition and the second call. The test expects promise2 to fail, but both succeed.

tests.name: Should release lock after transition completes
Should allow rollback from ACTIVE state
Should record rollback in audit trail
Should reject rollback from non-ACTIVE states
tests.errorMessage: Expected function to throw 'Rollback only allowed from ACTIVE state' but received function did not throw
tests.rootCause: Test uses sync expect(()=>sm.rollback()).toThrow() but rollback() is an async function. The sync wrapper does not catch the rejected promise. Jest .toThrow() only catches synchronous throws. Fix: use await expect(sm.rollback()).rejects.toThrow()

tests.name: Should throw error when no rollback target found
tests.errorMessage: Expected function to throw but received function did not throw
tests.rootCause: Same root cause as T-023: sync expect().toThrow() cannot catch async function rejections. rollback() is async and rejects, but the sync wrapper returns a promise, not a thrown error.

tests.name: Should support state timeline queries
tests.errorMessage: Cannot rollback from state SUBMITTED. Rollback only allowed from ACTIVE state. (and also Cannot rollback from state DRAFT)
tests.rootCause: Test T-030 is grouped in 'State Timeline Integration' describe block. The test body starts with transition calls and delay(), but the test fails because it appears Jest is running T-023/T-024 failure side effects (the rollback error) inside T-030's execution. The test itself doesn't call rollback - this is an artifact of the async test execution order and unhandled promise leakage from T-023.

tests.name: Should include valid transitions in error message
Should throw error when no rollback target found (second invocation artifact)
tests.errorMessage: Cannot rollback from state DRAFT. Rollback only allowed from ACTIVE state.
tests.rootCause: Same unhandled promise propagation from T-024 test creating side effects in T-030 execution context.

CONCURRENCY_BUG.description: Implementation bug: stateLock boolean does not actually block concurrent async calls in JavaScript single-threaded event loop
CONCURRENCY_BUG.agentAction: Agent-4 must fix state machine concurrency - use a Mutex or Promise-based lock instead of boolean flag

TEST_SYNC_BUG.description: Test bug: using sync expect().toThrow() on async rollback() function. Should use await expect().rejects.toThrow()
TEST_SYNC_BUG.agentAction: Agent-5 fix: update tests to use async assertion pattern

TEST_ORDERING_BUG.description: Cascade failure from T-023/T-024 unhandled promise rejection leaking into T-030 execution context
TEST_ORDERING_BUG.agentAction: Fix T-023/T-024 first; T-030 should then pass automatically
